workflow_transformations: The committed copy adds only a per-job `if:` gate (capture branch or vars.TOOLU_STEP_ATTRS_99_LIVE) to the workflow that ran, so captured token positions and run diagnostics point 1-3 lines above the same step in the committed copy.
capture_transformations: Acquired toolu-lane job messages from run 37992025403; secret variables and mask values replaced by deterministic version-5 UUID placeholders, and endpoint AccessToken values by `redacted`. Replays select steps by contextName; the composite replay swaps the captured composite_budget step's local path and drops its timeout.

S1.expected: Absent, literal, deferred (steps.*) and matrix attributes deserialize with their wire types; literal and expression continue-on-error give failure/success, literal false/0 and a negative timeout stay unbounded and green.
S1.live: attrs-*: steps 'Literal continue-on-error' through 'Check attribute results' succeed on both lanes.

S2.expected: fromJSON(steps.prior.outputs.minutes) kills a real sleep 600 after one minute with "The action 'Deferred timeout' has timed out after 1 minutes."; outcome failure, conclusion success.
S2.live: Identical timeout line on both lanes; 'Check deferred timeout' asserts the elapsed window and failure/success.

S3.expected: Zero/negative disable the bound, 1.9 truncates to one minute, a string timeout logs the two reference error lines and applies no bound, a string continue-on-error logs its two lines and keeps the failure; composite action.yml expressions behave the same.
S3.live: Timeout/continue-on-error error lines identical on both lanes (invalid-* fails on both); composite-coe-* succeeds on both with the same two lines, apart from the location prefix noted in differences.

S4.expected: Job-API names: 'Deferred from-prior', 'Matrix <lane> input ', 'Bad ${{ fromJSON(steps.prior.outputs.bad) }}', 'run', 'Run echo lane <lane>', 'Run echo prior from-prior', 'Pre Node pre and main stages', 'Post Run actions/checkout@v4'; failures warn in Set up job and again at the step; execution unaffected.
S4.live: Every step name and conclusion in the jobs API matches the reference lane (matrix lane substituted).

S5.expected: Composite children share one one-minute budget (the second sleep 40 is killed with 'The action has timed out.'); Node pre and main each get the full budget and both finish.
S5.live: 'Check composite budget' and 'Check Node stages' succeed on both lanes; the nested timeout line is identical.

differences: fromJSON parse failures in display-name warnings carry serde_json's message ('JSON error: expected ident at line 1 column 2') instead of Newtonsoft's; the warning prefix, token and position match.
Composite action.yml attribute errors omit upstream's '<action dir>/action.yml (Line: L, Col: C): ' prefix; the action manifest is parsed without positions.
Out of scope (step reporting, see #88): the toolu lane numbers the pre step 0, lists the checkout post twice, has no 'Complete job' row, and its exit-code trailer reports 1 without ##[error].
